answer: An agent economy can keep fake identities scarce by bonding whole clusters together: agents that share a funding source or attestation path post one joint ripple bond, and a single fake in the cluster forfeits the entire bond, so an attacker must give every fake its own separate funding and history or watch one bad actor drain the river of stake behind it. A public jade record ties each cluster to its bond, so the cost of a fake army grows with every identity, and no parallel compute can manufacture the independent histories a thousand separate clusters would need.
